[SWS_DM_01021] DisableRapidPowerShutdown processing
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04279
⌈
If
DisableRapidPowerShutdown
request is received, the DM shall trigger a call
of
ara::diag::EcuResetRequest::EnableRapidShutdown
with
enable
set to
FALSE
, if it is configured as per [SWS_DM_00100].
⌋
7.3.2.8.5.2 Service 0x11 – ECUReset – all other sub functions
